headline: The shop is appointment drop-off on Coogan Way. Yellow Pages still pins Chase Lane.
summary: This is a real family trailer shop at 340 Coogan Way in El Cajon. Dustin and Carrie already show up in the reviews. Yelp is claimed, updated this month, about 32 notes. The phone is (619) 623-5715. The shop this week prints ectrfab@gmail.com and drop-off by appointment only. Shop-owned hours and Yelp print Monday through Friday 8 to 4:30, Saturday closed. Giftly still prints 8 to 5. Birdeye still prints 9 to 6 on leftover 1657 Chase Lane. The hours widget this Saturday morning still reads open today. A neighbor with a bent axle can drive to Chase Lane, or roll up without a time, and find a door that is not set up that way.

signals.note: You show up for trailer repair in El Cajon. Yelp is claimed, 4.4 from about 32 reviews, updated this month. People already ask for Dustin and Carrie by name. A neighbor looking for brakes, axles, or a boat bunk can find you. Yelp still files the shop under boat repair. That is the wrong hallway for a trailer yard.
